comment: Load order for the single-file build and for Node tools. Every file attaches to the global namespace T; later files may use anything defined by earlier ones. The playtest files are added only to the playtest build (npm run build:playtest). The same list builds the web version (npm run build:web), which loads the scripts, styles and art as separate cacheable files.

web.comment: Only in the web version (npm run build:web): the scripts that talk to Froglet's own services, Tumult's Worker (server/, docs/reference/BACKEND.md) and Froglet Analytics, and the online screens they serve. The offline file never contains them. The backend provider comes before the online screens, which look for it as they load.

audio.comment: Cosmic Shore's music and effects (assets/README.md). The web version names every file by its content and fetches each when it is first wanted; the offline file inlines every effect and only the music listed under offline, so it stays a reasonable size.

art.comment: Inlined by tools/build.mjs as data URIs (assets/README.md says where each piece comes from and its licence).
